WHY 4 REMODEL
Built Around How You Actually Live

Remodeling is never just tile and countertops — it's permits, schedules, and a hundred small decisions. We handle all of it under one roof, with clear communication, fair pricing, and clean workmanship, so you deal with one team from the first sketch to the final walkthrough.

01
In-House Design + Build

One team designs it, permits it, and builds it — nothing gets lost in translation between an architect, a contractor, and a sub.

02
Fixed-Price Contracts

Your price is set before a single wall comes down, with no change-order surprises once work begins.

03
Licensed Florida General Contractor

Fully licensed and insured, with every permit filed correctly the first time.

04
Built for Hurricane Code

Impact windows, wind-rated construction, and materials specified to meet South Florida's building code from day one.

05
One Project Manager, Start to Finish

A single point of contact who answers the phone — not a rotating cast of subcontractors.

06
5-Year Warranty

We stand behind our work with a full 5-year warranty, long after the last coat of paint dries.

OUR PROCESS
From First Call to Final Walkthrough
01
Discovery Call

A 15-minute conversation about your goals, timeline, and budget.

02
In-Home Consultation

We walk the space and talk through what's structurally possible.

03
Design & Selections

Layout, materials, and finishes finalized with 3D renderings.

04
Fixed-Price Proposal

One clear number, in writing, before any work begins.

05
Permitting & Scheduling

Every permit filed with your city, and a locked construction schedule.

06
Build & Walkthrough

We build to plan and walk every room with you before calling it done.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Good to Know Before You Call
Are you licensed and insured in Florida?

Yes. 4 Remodel is a licensed Florida General Contractor (CGC) and fully insured for every project we build.

How long does a typical remodel take?

A bathroom remodel typically takes 4–6 weeks, a kitchen 6–10 weeks, and a full home renovation 4–8 months, depending on scope and permitting.

Do you handle permits?

Yes — permitting is handled in-house with your city's building department as part of every project.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Boca Raton, Parkland, Coral Springs, Deerfield Beach, Pompano Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, Weston, and Delray Beach.

Do you offer financing?

Yes, including promotional 0% APR plans for qualified homeowners. Ask your project specialist for current options.

How much does a remodel cost?

It depends on scope and finishes. Bathroom remodels typically start around $10,000 and kitchens around $20,000. Use the Instant Estimate tool above for a range specific to your project.

SUMMER BATHROOM REMODELING IN TEXAS: WHY HOMEOWNERS ARE UPGRADING
July 17, 2026
9:56 pm
FACEBOOK
 
TWITTER
 
LINKEDIN

Summer is one of the busiest seasons for home improvement projects across Texas—and for good reason. Longer days, flexible schedules, and favorable remodeling conditions make it an ideal time to transform your bathroom.

Whether you’re considering a new walk-in shower, a tub-to-shower conversion, or a complete bathroom upgrade, remodeling during the summer allows you to enjoy the results long before the holiday season arrives.

Here’s why so many homeowners throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex choose to remodel during the summer months.

Complete Your Project Before the Holidays

Many homeowners wait until fall or winter to start remodeling, only to discover contractor schedules are already filling up.

By remodeling during the summer, you can:

Finish your project before holiday gatherings
Avoid last-minute scheduling delays
Enjoy your new bathroom sooner
Prepare your home for visiting family and guests

Planning ahead gives you greater flexibility and peace of mind.

Upgrade Before Everyday Wear Gets Worse

Bathrooms experience constant daily use. Small issues such as worn showers, outdated fixtures, and difficult-to-clean surfaces rarely improve over time.

Summer is a great opportunity to replace:

Aging showers
Cracked shower walls
Outdated bathtubs

How much does a kitchen renovation typically cost?

Kitchen renovation costs vary, but here’s a general guide: Smaller kitchens, like condos or galley kitchens, typically cost $35,000–$50,000. Medium-sized kitchens range from $50,000–$80,000, while larger or custom kitchens start at $80,000 and can go higher depending on the level of luxury and customization.

How much does a master bathroom renovation typically cost?

It usually depends on the size of the space and if we are moving the layout around. A master suite renovation with high-end custom tile, new vanities, and premium fixtures generally starts around $45,000 to $55,000. For major renovations where we are tearing down walls, expanding the shower, or adding a freestanding soaking tub, projects typically range from $65,000 to $85,000+.

About Bath Renew Of Central New York
Bath Renew of Syracuse began in 2003 as a one-man operation and has grown into the region’s most trusted name in bathroom remodeling. Our family-owned business completes more bathroom remodeling projects than any other company in the area! Though we’ve expanded our services and service areas, we have maintained an unwavering commitment to quality work and exceptional customer service.

Because we’re not a franchise, our customers deal directly with the business owners—and we are 100% committed to customer satisfaction. Our affordable bath remodeling solutions and attractive financing options make it easy to get the quality bathroom makeover you deserve. Bath Renew has received the “Bath Wraps Excellence Award” every year since 2006. While we are proud of these accolades, what means the most to us is hearing the positive reviews from our long list of satisfied customers.
A Bathroom Remodeling Company That Loves Giving Back
As a member of the Syracuse community, we love helping our neighbors give their outdated bathrooms a makeover with our durable acrylic products—but that’s not all we do! We’re also active in many well-known charities, and we regularly participate in fundraising efforts throughout the community. We’ve worked with Upstate Golisano Children’s Hospital, Miracle Ride, McMahon-Ryan Child Advocacy Center, and many other organizations. Giving back to the community is a big part of who we are, and we’re always looking for ways to help.
Providing Expert Bath Remodels Throughout Central New York

About Ben Rae Design & Remodel

At Ben Rae Design & Remodel, we believe that exceptional design should feel both elevated and attainable. Our approach blends thoughtful craftsmanship, refined style, and practical investment—so homeowners can create spaces they truly love without unnecessary excess.

From kitchens and bathrooms to full home transformations, we focus on clean design, functional layouts, and attention to detail at every stage. Every project is guided by clear communication, transparency, and a commitment to delivering results that feel both beautiful and livable.

What Sets Us Apart
✔ Design-driven remodeling with a modern aesthetic
✔ Clear process from concept to completion
✔ Balanced approach to quality and cost
✔ Attention to detail in every finish
Our Approach

We start by understanding how you live in your space, then translate that into a design that feels natural, functional, and elevated. Our goal is not just to remodel—but to create an environment that improves how you experience your home every day.

Our Story

Founded by Woody and Kim Moldenhauer, Ben Rae Design & Remodel is a husband-and-wife-owned company built on craftsmanship, trust, and family values. We believe the heart of every home is where life happens — where families gather, memories are made, and everyday moments matter most.

Woody’s career began in the field as an installer, learning the trade through hands-on experience and a commitment to doing things the right way. That foundation was shaped early on by his father, a union carpenter whose expertise across every facet of remodeling instilled a deep respect for quality workmanship and pride in the craft.

Over the years, Woody transitioned into the design and business side of the industry, spending more than 14 years refining his ability to guide projects from concept to completion with both creativity and precision.

Today, Woody and Kim lead a team with more than 35 years of combined experience, creating spaces that are thoughtfully designed, expertly built, and centered around the people who call them home. At Ben Rae Design & Remodel, every project is approached with the same care, integrity, and attention to detail we would want for our own family.

It’s your house.

Your home may have the right location, the right memories and much of what you already love. But the way it works no longer fits the way you live.

That’s where Cowdin comes in.

FAQ's
What cabinetry is offered?

We offer a variety of cabinetry including quick ship, semi custom, full custom and our own fully custom Halco Cabinet. We can design with all price points and styles of cabinetry including overlay, inset and frameless designs.

What is the anticipated timeline?

Interior remodeling 5-7 weeks, project dependent

Addition 12-16 weeks, project dependent

New Construction 6 months - 1 year, project dependent

What is the warranty?

5 Year warranty on all associated projects. Limited lifetime warranty on cabinetry.

What to expect during a remodel?

When a contract has been signed and a deposit is placed, the project moves into the construction phase. A team member will be in touch regarding the schedule and an anticipated start date. You will be given access to your projects online portal where you can review the schedule and associated project documents.

You will be responsible for removing necessary objects from the project area (empty out cabinetry, move furniture, put away décor, etc.)

Our team will secure the area with floor protection and put up plastic walls to decrease the amount of dust and debris from exiting the work area.

We will then work through demo, framing and rough mechanicals, which will all need to be signed off by the town inspector.

Following passed inspections, the board will be hung, finished materials installed and mechanicals completed.

Any final inspections will take place at this time.

How do I start?

It is best to begin the process with a discovery phone call or an in-home consultation. This will allow our team to gain a better understanding of your project and how we can best serve you. We will talk you through our process and answer any initial questions you may have.

Design-Build Kitchen, Bathroom, and Outdoor Remodeling in Georgetown, Texas

Hoeft Design Build helps Georgetown-area homeowners plan and build high-quality kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, and outdoor living projects. We combine design guidance, realistic budgeting, and construction management under one roof so your project moves from concept to completion with less guesswork and fewer handoff problems.

Our work is built around clear communication, strong craftsmanship, and a process that helps you make good decisions before construction starts.

Request Free Consultation
512-547-7009
Project Planning and Estimate

We start with scope, goals, and budget alignment. Whether you are planning a kitchen, bathroom, or outdoor living area project, we build the estimate around the real work required so you can make informed next-step decisions.

Design and Scope Alignment

Our design phase can include as-built drawings, layout planning, finish selections, and renderings when needed. If your remodel involves reconfiguring a bathroom, replacing kitchen cabinetry, or building a new patio or covered outdoor space, this step helps everyone align before construction begins.

Construction Agreement

Before work starts, we document the project clearly with scope, pricing, payment schedule, and job expectations. That gives you a cleaner handoff into construction and fewer surprises once the project is underway.

Construction and Project Management

Once preconstruction is complete, our team manages the build through completion. You get a dedicated point of contact, a defined process, and steady communication from kickoff through final walkthrough.

NATALIE BEACH

Natalie Beach is the founder and creative force behind Kitchen Envy and Tile Envy. An award-winning designer, she has expanded the business into a leading design firm known for its elevated aesthetic and thoughtful execution. Her background in interior design, business and sales, enriches her work with both creativity and strategy, allowing her wide range of skills to uniquely guide each project.

Since founding Kitchen Envy in 2011, Natalie has transformed the company into a full-service firm, personally selecting a team that ensures the projects’ growth nationwide. These projects span multiple states, including a multimillion-dollar historic renovation in Princeton and an astronaut's residence in Texas.

Her distinguished eye is evident in designs like these, earning her multiple awards, repeat placement on the Beaches Tour of Homes, editorial recognition in local magazines like Babes Who Hustle, and features in various national publications. 

Despite the ever-expanding reach of her company, Natalie remains an active part of  the projects, providing intentional oversight in each design’s direction and ensuring a consistently high standard of quality across the Kitchen Envy brand.

Her work provides the structure that allows the design team to focus on the creative, while she remains actively involved in the company’s strategic growth as it continues to expand.

A little more About Us at Manzer Contracting

The local go-to general contractor in the North Atlanta Metro Area

GET A QUOTE

In 1999, William Manzer struggled to find a quality contractor to complete a home renovation that he and his family were looking to complete. The North Atlanta Metro area had a ton of great tradespeople, but it lacked that general contractor to complete whole home remodeling or kitchen and bath remodeling. As he thought about it more, he decided that it was time that the North Atlanta Metro area had their own general contracting company that could help out homeowners just like him. Thus, Manzer Contracting was born.

Our Mission

Today, Manzer Contracting is one of the top general contractors in the state and looks to assist homeowners in enhancing, maintaining, and repairing their homes. As a one-stop shop, Manzer believes that providing long-term solutions with premium materials is the best way to ensure a remodel stands the test of time. Manzer will do it right the first time, whether you are looking for a small job or a total home remodel.

Our Team

We have assembled one of the top rosters of tradespeople, contractors and laborers in the region, and our work speaks for itself. We pride ourselves in our ability to deliver a customer's vision to their home, and we do it every time with our in-house approach. From hardscaping to kitchen remodeling, Manzer's staff continues to deliver a professional and detail-oriented service that leaves our clients wowed.

Our Commitment

At Manzer, honesty and ethics are essential, and we ensure that our clients enjoy clear communication and accurate billing. We are not a big city firm that does not care. Instead, we are a local company that will go above and beyond to ensure our clients love their work and recommend us going forward.

A Tech Focus

Unlike other options, our team embraces technology and the latest gadgets for our clients. This means our team can do it if you are looking to set up a connected home or need the latest in fiber optic or wiring. We love tech, and our designers will work with you to ensure you can include as much tech as you want in your remodel.

About Our Company

Since 1984, our owner and founder, Peter Duffy, has been remodeling homes across the Greater Boston Area. Peter has been at the forefront of some of the region's top remodels for over 40 years, from smaller projects to complex multi-level remodels. 

So, what does this mean for our clients? Well, it means that Remodeling Boston has made its name in the industry due to our expertise and experience on job sites. We strive to work with our clients and want to understand your needs and wants which then can allow us to provide meaningful solutions for your remodeling project.

Our Commitment

For the team at Remodeling Boston, our commitment is quite simple. We want to ensure that our clients:

Get the most for their investment, no matter the size of the project. 
Get a space that they will love for years to come.
Enjoy a seamless project from start to finish, including accurate timelines and transparent pricing.

So, if you are tired of working with remodeling companies that are not putting you first, it is time to work with the real and genuine contractors. We will work with and alongside you to ensure your remodel goes smoothly from quote to finish.

About SoCal Design + Build
Built on Innovation, Strength, and Expertise

Founded in 2005, SoCal Design + Build was established with a clear mission: to revolutionize the construction industry through vertical integration. We saw the inefficiencies of traditional building models—reliance on multiple third-party vendors, unpredictable timelines, and inconsistent quality. So we took control of the entire process. From concept to completion, we design, manufacture, and build all under one roof.

Our Mission

At SoCal Design + Build, our goal is simple: to deliver unmatched quality, efficiency, and value in every project we take on. By managing every aspect of the process in-house, we eliminate common industry delays and cost overruns, ensuring a seamless experience for our clients.

SoCal Strong: What Sets Us Apart

We believe in strength—in our people, our process, and our products. Our team of skilled designers, engineers, and builders work collaboratively to bring visions to life. By leveraging advanced manufacturing techniques and high-quality materials, we create structures that stand the test of time.

Vertical Integration – Our factory is your advantage. Complete control means better quality, faster turnarounds, and cost savings.

Precision Craftsmanship – Every component is built to exacting standards, ensuring durability and aesthetic excellence.

Sustainability & Innovation – We use cutting-edge technologies and eco-friendly materials to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
State-of-the-Art Facility

At the heart of SoCal Design + Build is our advanced manufacturing facility, equipped with industry-leading technology to ensure the highest quality craftsmanship. Our facility includes:

State-of-the-Art CNC Machines – Delivering precise, high-quality cuts for custom builds.

Manufacturer on Demand Capabilities – Enabling quick and efficient production.

Full Finishing Shop – Ensuring the perfect final touches on every piece.

Climate-Controlled Spray Booth – Providing expert staining and finishing for long-lasting beauty.

Modern Cabinet Shop Equipment – Incorporating the latest tools and processes to create high-end cabinetry.

Full Stone Yard – Offering a comprehensive selection of granite, marble, and stone materials through our sister company. 

Stone Cutting & Finishing Shop – Delivering precision-cut stone for countertops, flooring, and architectural details through our sister company.
Our Legacy, Your Future

With nearly two decades of industry leadership, SoCal Design + Build continues to redefine what’s possible in construction. Backed by our parent company, PacWes, we bring a legacy of innovation and expertise to every project. Whether you’re a homeowner, business owner, or developer, we’re here to build something extraordinary—together.

SEE HOW YOUR HOME REMODEL COMES TOGETHER IN 6 CLEAR STEPS
BOOK YOUR FREE ESTIMATE
01: START WITH AN INTRODUCTORY MEETING

To kick off the remodeling process, you'll have a call with Tim, the owner of Steiner Remodel. This first conversation helps us understand your Portland home, the space you want to remodel, your timeline, and the budget range you have in mind. We’ll talk through what’s prompting the project, what you want to improve, and whether Steiner Remodel is the right fit before scheduling an in-home consultation.

02: IN-HOME CONSULTATION

Next, we’ll visit your home to better understand the space, your goals, and how you want your remodel to function and feel once complete. During this consultation, you’ll walk us through what’s currently working, what isn’t, and the changes you want to make. This meeting also helps us begin shaping the design direction and establish a preliminary project cost range.

03: REVIEW YOUR PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE AND NEXT STEPS

Join us in our conference room or over video call to review the preliminary estimate for your remodel. Questions are strongly encouraged at this stage, so you can feel confident and informed before moving forward. If you like what you see, a reasonable fee will begin the Project Planning Agreement (PPA) process. While separate from the construction contract, the PPA covers the detailed planning needed before construction begins, including design services, scope development, and a more detailed contract. If needed, the process may also include limited exploratory demolition to help minimize surprises and create more accurate project pricing. Should you move forward with Steiner Remodel for construction, a portion of the PPA fee may be credited toward the construction phase.

04: REFINE THE DESIGN AND FINALIZE THE PLAN IN DETAIL

We’ll begin by carefully measuring your home and creating the initial plans for your remodel, layout, and new space. Then, we’ll review the design together and refine it based on your feedback, preferences, and goals for the project. This phase also includes selecting finishes and finalizing important project details. Once everything is aligned, we’ll prepare a detailed construction contract with a fixed price and clearly defined scope of work.

05: COORDINATE PERMITS, SCHEDULING, AND PROJECT PLANNING

Now it’s your turn to relax as we begin preparing your project for construction. We’ll work with the city building department and trusted subcontractors to secure permits, coordinate scheduling, and finalize the details needed to keep your remodel moving smoothly. Once complete, you’ll receive access to an easy-to-follow project schedule that automatically updates throughout the remodeling process so you always know what’s happening next, 24 hours a day.

06: CONSTRUCTION AND FINAL DETAILS

Before construction begins, our team will implement a site plan to help protect your home, including isolating the work area and setting up protective barriers where needed.Next comes demolition, followed by the “rough-in” stage, where framing, electrical, plumbing, and other core systems are installed. After inspections and a walkthrough with the team, we’ll begin installing finishes and bringing the design to life. Once construction is complete, we’ll conduct a final walkthrough together so you can fully enjoy your newly remodeled space.

• OUR MISSION •
REMODELING SHOULDN'T FEEL LIKE A GAMBLE

Remodeling is one of the biggest investments homeowners will ever make. Unfortunately, the industry is full of contractors who overpromise, underbid projects, disappear mid-job, or raise prices after the project is already underway.

It's no surprise that many Portland homeowners approach the process with caution. They want to know that the team they're hiring will communicate clearly, follow through on their commitments, and deliver quality work that lives up to expectations.

That's why Steiner Remodel was built differently.

From the beginning, the goal wasn't to become the biggest remodeling company in Portland. It was to create the kind of experience homeowners deserve—one built on honest pricing, clear communication, thoughtful problem-solving, exceptional craftsmanship, and a team that stays personally invested from design through construction.

Those principles have guided Steiner Remodel for more than 16 years, and they continue to shape every project the company takes on.

Meet the Leadership Team Behind Steiner Remodel

Get to know the people responsible for the relationships and reputation Steiner Remodel has built since 2010.

TIM STEINER

CEO & DESIGNER

Tim founded Steiner Remodel in 2010 after combining his passion for construction with years of hands-on carpentry experience, a certificate in Building Technology, and three years of business management studies at Portland State University. He started the company with a simple goal: to provide homeowners with the quality, craftsmanship, and experience they deserve. Over the past 16 years, Tim has helped homeowners throughout Portland transform kitchens, bathrooms, basements, additions, and entire homes. His unique combination of structural and design knowledge allows him to solve complex challenges while keeping projects focused on his clients' goals. Known for his calm approach, honest communication, and commitment to doing things the right way, Tim remains personally involved throughout every project and believes that lasting relationships are just as important as the finished result.

MIKE VERA

PROJECT MANAGER AND ESTIMATOR

Mike got his start in construction in 2004 in Boston, MA, and has built a career defined by versatility and expertise. With two decades under his belt, he brings specialized skills in tile setting, concrete work, structural framing, and building envelope systems, along with a mastery of both interior and exterior finishes.

His background in custom carpentry and project management lets him approach each project with a well-rounded perspective, ensuring quality and precision at every stage. He's committed to delivering exceptional results, combining technical skill with a deep understanding of what makes each project unique.

JESSE ASPY

PROJECT MANAGER

Jesse runs Steiner Remodel’s projects in the field, from the first day of demo through the final cleanup. He coordinates our crews and trade partners, keeps the schedule moving, and is the day-to-day point of contact for our clients while their home is under construction. Jesse has been with Steiner Remodel since 2018 and brings 12 years of experience in site development, concrete, framing, building envelope, millworks, interior finish, and fine finish carpentry. He’s known for clear, detailed communication with homeowners. Outside of work, Jesse is an active musician and loves building carpentry projects in his garage shop.

ABOUT US

We are are located in the prettiest coastal town of St. Michaels, MD on the Eastern Shore & in the heart of Georgetown.

Our St. Michaels location serves the Delmarva Peninsula & Annapolis area.

Our Georgetown location serves the beltway areas of Washington, DC, Northern Virginia & Maryland.

We are an hour from Annapolis & just under two hours from Washington, DC. A great day trip!

Our Team is professional, knowledgeable, friendly & is here to help you through your remodeling journey.

Our Staff is passionate about our work. We will take the time to listen to you & use our expertise to find design and product solutions that work for you. We do everything possible to give you a five-star treatment.

Our Products are carefully selected to provide the highest-quality choices with your needs, desires & budget. We supply cabinetry, countertops, range hoods, bath & kitchen fixtures, cabinet hardware, tile & stone, flooring, and select appliances. We work with directly with retail clients or through the trade.

Our Company Story

Saint Michaels Fine Woodworking began in 2015 with a mission to create something meaningful and enduring. Having lived in the Washington, DC Metro area for over four decades and drawing from experiences across Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, and North America, I was inspired to build a business that embodies the spirit of ‘Made in America.’ My vision was to create a legacy company that adds great value in the markets we serve by simplifying the process and delivering the promise.

In the early days, we were a small boutique cabinet operation, relying solely on referrals and crafting custom solutions for every client. A defining moment came in 2019, when we opened our first showroom in Saint Michaels, St. Michaels Kitchen and Bath, and the next year a design office in Georgetown, Washington, DC. This expansion, combined with increased technology in production, marked a turning point, allowing us to reach more clients and provide a more seamless, one-stop solution for design, product, and installation.

Our journey has been shaped by incredible people: mentors who inspired excellence and integrity, customers who shared their dreams, and vendors who modeled partnerships. Through these relationships, we are building a company driven by core values: Integrity, Leadership, Excellence, Innovation, Partnership, Value and Doing Good. These principles guide everything we do.

Our mission is simple: to deliver excellence. Whether through superior service, expertly crafted products, or a seamless delivery process, we strive to do what we say we will do. This commitment drives every decision we make. Our team lives these values every day, ensuring we consistently exceed customer expectations.

Today, we are a growing company focused on improving our people, processes, and products. Our leadership style centers on empowering team members to take ownership, ensuring high standards and accountability. We are seen as a high-value brand that delivers exceptional quality and reliability—earning trust, referrals, and repeat customers.

Looking ahead, our vision is to build a holistic company that fully meets our customers’ needs. Over the next 12 months, we will continue refining our systems and engaging our target market. In the next five years, we aim to serve more customers with excellence while growing a team of lifelong learners, innovators, and high achievers.

The legacy we aim to leave is one of lasting relationships and meaningful impact. We want our customers to enjoy our products for years, trust our services, and see us as the go-to destination for quality and reliability. Together, we are building a company that makes the world a better place—one project, one customer, and one team member at a time.

Our Story

At TroY Design & Build, construction isn’t just a business; it’s a legacy passed down through generations. Founded by Yoel and Tal, our company embodies decades of expertise and passion for building excellence.

With Tal’s father as a seasoned builder and Yoel’s father as a distinguished civil engineer, our roots in the construction industry run deep. Inspired by their dedication to craftsmanship and innovation, we continue their legacy by delivering superior quality and unparalleled service to our clients.

At TroY Design & Build, we blend traditional craftsmanship with modern techniques, ensuring each project is executed with precision and care. From residential developments to commercial complexes, our team is committed to exceeding expectations every step of the way.

With a foundation built on experience, integrity, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, we invite you to partner with us for your next construction project. Together, let’s build the future, one exceptional structure at a time.

Reliability

Our award-winning design-build company has been delighting clients since 1988.

Founded over three decades ago, Custom Design & Construction provides an unparalleled remodeling experience for the South Bay area. From whole house to additions to kitchens to bathrooms, our committed team can handle any remodeling project with ease.

Here’s what sets us apart from other remodeling companies: 

Design-Build Approach

We'll be the single point of accountability for your entire remodeling project—start to finish.

Immersive Design Center

Our El Segundo design center helps you visualize details when making decisions about your space.

Award-Winning Designs

Home Remodeling Financing

Our financing options for clients are streamlined, simplified, and feature no closing costs or fees. 

Collaborative & Communicative 

We take customer service seriously, and we've proudly earned a 93% client satisfaction rate since 1988.

Industry-Leading Warranty

We stand by our craftsmanship and provide a generous warranty to clients for peace of mind.

We’ve built a legacy for providing exceptional client experience.

Beth Yuen

Director of Design/President

Beth has a gift for capturing the essence of each client within their home. Prior to joining Custom Design & Construction in 2009, she earned a decade’s worth of industry experience through designing everything from residential powder rooms to casino gaming floors.

With a keen understanding of her clients’ visions, Beth fosters a collaborative design process that puts clients at ease. As a Certified Interior Designer (CID #6925), Beth brings both creative vision and technical expertise to her projects. Her designs maximize possibilities with consideration to structure and budget.

Beth has earned a positive reputation for her flexibility, and she presents clients with numerous options for review before remodeling. She has a deep knowledge of materials and finishes, and she’s able to help clients make grounded decisions on where to splurge and where to save—without compromising on the final result.

When she’s not bringing clients’ dreams to life, Beth is an avid cyclist and athlete. She became an Ironman in Mont Tremblant in 2022.

Chelsea Cutler

Designer/General Manager

As General Manager, Chelsea oversees every phase of a project, from demolition to move-in day and beyond. She ensures that pre construction development aligns design dreams with a feasible plan that homeowners will cherish for years to come.

With 12 years of experience in the building industry, Chelsea has a rich background in account management, working with a diverse range of clients from small businesses to Fortune 500 companies. This experience has honed her ability to navigate complex projects and deliver outstanding results. Chelsea is known for bringing insight-driven, innovative solutions to every endeavor and excels in cultivating strong team and partner relationships throughout the design-build process.

Outside of her role as CDC’s Chief Cheerleader, Chelsea enjoys spending time with family and friends, creating lasting memories often centered around delicious meals and hearty laughter.

Rachel Ponder

Senior Designer

As Senior Designer for Custom Design & Construction, Rachel has a rare ability to translate clients’ stories, lifestyles, and priorities into one-of-a-kind spaces. She believes the “Custom” in our name should be felt in every detail, and since joining the team in 2019, she has continually impressed clients with her thoughtful space planning, material selections, and immersive 3D renderings.

Rachel earned a BFA in Interior Architectural Design from Cal State Long Beach and has been designing residential spaces since 2011. Her experience spans boutique high-end residential work, mass kitchen design with Ikea, and even running her own shop. These experiences have sharpened both her creative instincts and entrepreneurial mindset, allowing her to bring a deep well of knowledge, curiosity, and heart to every project.

Beginning in 2023, Rachel expanded her education by traveling the world to study sustainable design practices. Her research has taken her to Bamboo U in Bali, Space Available in Jakarta, the School of Constructive Arts in West Texas, and the Mojave Center and Cal-Earth Institute in California. With New Mexico and North Africa next on her list, Rachel continues to seek inspiration that informs more thoughtful, responsible, and beautiful design.

Jorge Arias

Architectural Designer

As Architectural Designer at Custom Design & Construction, Jorge brings our design visions to life by creating a concrete plan and layout for our construction plans. With careful consideration to building specifications, building and zone requirements, and the overall goals of the project, Jorge acts as the glue between the design and construction phases in remodeling.

Prior to joining Custom Design & Construction in 2019, Jorge earned two decades of experience overseeing architectural design for residential (single homes and apartments) and commercial buildings, including field measurements, city submittals, and client coordination.

Jorge possesses a Bachelor of Architecture from Universida Autonoma de Guadalajara.

In his free time, Jorge enjoys riding his bike along the beach and playing tennis and racquetball. His love for architecture is matched by his passion for music. He enjoys attending live concerts and composing New Age music. He has released two studio albums, one of which was recognized among the Ten Best New Age albums in 2019.

Kim Mejia

Office & Operations Manager

Kim plays a crucial role at Custom Design & Construction as Office & Operations Manager. She oversees the day-to-day running of the office, from scheduling and vendor coordination to invoicing, compliance, and team onboarding, and supports each project from pre-construction through to warranty check-ins. With a sharp eye for detail and a talent for keeping systems organized, Kim makes sure our design and production teams have everything they need to do their best work.

Before joining Custom Design & Construction, Kim spent five years in construction office management, where she handled everything from financial records to payroll, ensuring smooth operations behind the scenes. Her combined experience in management and design gives her a unique perspective in her current role.

Kim holds an Architectural Design Skills Certificate and an AutoCAD Skills Certificate and was honored with the prestigious IR Architects Scholarship Award. She’s also pursuing a Bachelor of Architecture, set to begin in Fall 2025.

Outside of the office, Kim enjoys exploring the city with her adventurous 5-year-old, visiting museums, and attending live concerts to see her favorite bands.

Chris Farkas

Production Manager

Chris is a trusted leader at Custom Design & Construction, guiding projects from early planning through final completion. With a unique blend of military discipline and high-end construction experience, he brings precision and consistency to every build.

Before joining CD&C, Chris spent eight years in the U.S. Army, serving in leadership roles ranging from commanding a Tank Platoon to directing Battalion Reconnaissance Scouts. After his military service, he managed luxury custom home builds in Malibu and Park City, UT, as well as major hotel developments and historic residential remodels. What drives him most is watching a design come to life as a finished home that reflects a client’s vision.

Chris earned his Bachelor of Science in Construction Management from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo, with a minor in Military Science, and is proud to have completed the Army’s elite Sapper School for leadership and engineering.

Outside of work, he’s almost always on the move, whether he’s working out, golfing, skiing, running, or jumping into a competitive game of pickleball.

Ryan Mejia

Project Manager

With a passion for construction kindled during his college days working in the industry, Ryan now proudly follows in his father's footsteps. His 7 years of experience in construction, culminating in his current role as a Project Manager at Custom Design & Construction, reflect his dedication and skill. Ryan is responsible for overseeing projects from the initial planning stages to the final touches of post-production. His key focus is ensuring that each project adheres to the company's high standards while staying on schedule.

Ryan's approach to project management is grounded in efficient planning and organization, ensuring a streamlined process. He places great importance on listening to clients' concerns and addressing them promptly and effectively. His recent certification as a Certified Remodeling Project Manager (CRPM) from the National Association of the Remodeling Industry (NARI) is a testament to his commitment and expertise.

With three years of college education in business logistics and management, Ryan has a solid foundation in the principles of good business practice. His personal philosophy is to treat clients with the utmost respect and consideration, just as he would expect to be treated.

Outside of work, Ryan is a car enthusiast who enjoys playing baseball and soccer. He has an avid interest in music, having seen an impressive 145 music acts live. As for his professional aspirations, Ryan aims to continue his growth within the company, seeking a more influential decision-making role in the future.

Lito Berganza

Field Supervisor

Lito is our glue and go-to for bringing our construction projects to life. Thorough and committed, he keeps our projects on track by ensuring materials are ready to go and tasks are running smoothly. We love how Lito is a reliable team player, and we can always count on him to help wherever needed. 

Prior to joining our team, Lito earned initial site experience as a painter, which included area preparation and supporting projects to completion.

In his spare time, Lito likes to fish and dirtbike riding with his brothers.

Roberto Melchor

Remodel Specialist

Roberto, a jack-of-all-trades with a particular expertise in tile laying, brings over 20 years of experience to Custom Design & Construction. His dedication to craftsmanship and adherence to our company's high standards makes him a valued team member.

His hands-on training and willingness to continuously learn have shaped his professional philosophy. Roberto believes that there is always room for growth and new knowledge in his field. This mindset not only enhances his work but also contributes positively to our team dynamic.

When not laying tiles to perfection, Roberto enjoys watching movies with his family. His favorite film is The Notebook. He looks forward to bringing unique and beautiful tilework to Custom Design & Construction’s clients.

Fernando Arana

Painter

Fernando joined Custom Design & Construction with six months of experience as a painter, quickly becoming known for his attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality work. He takes great pride in ensuring clients are satisfied with every project.

With an academic background in nursing, Fernando brings a unique focus on precision and avoiding mistakes in his craft. Outside of work, he enjoys making new friends and watching soccer.

Tiffany Mejia

Apprentice

Tiffany Mejia is an apprentice at Custom Design & Construction, specializing in carpentry, tile work, and painting. She supports the team by refining the finishing touches on projects, ensuring each detail meets CDC’s high quality standards. With her commitment and keen attention to detail, Tiffany contributes significantly to bringing each client's vision to life.

Prior to joining CDC, Tiffany gained valuable experience supervising in the retail pharmacy sector. Her career shift reflects her passion for craftsmanship and her desire to create tangible, lasting results in home construction and renovation.

Holding both an Associate’s and a Bachelor’s degree in Diagnostic Medical Sonography, Tiffany applies her methodical and meticulous approach—developed through her educational background—to her construction work.

Tiffany finds her work most rewarding when she sees the joy her craftsmanship brings to homeowners. Knowing she has helped create a home that clients will cherish for years fuels her passion for the construction industry.

Outside of her professional life, Tiffany enjoys attending music festivals, camping adventures, baking, and creating handcrafted gifts for special events.

Bill Simone

Founder

Since founding Custom Design & Construction, Bill has proven that it’s possible to have great design, product selections, construction, project management, and in-house financing—all under the same roof. Bill helped pioneer the design-build company concept, which is now widely accepted as a superior experience for high-end residential remodels.

Outside of Custom Design & Construction, Bill has served as President of the National Association of Home Builders Los Angeles Remodelers Council, Vice President of the Building Industry Association of Southern California, and he’s a certified graduate remodeler, certified aging in place specialist and EPA lead-safe expert. Bill serves on the board for Harvard University's Joint Center for Housing Studies, which brings together the brightest minds in the industry, including product manufacturers, economists, media editors and government agencies.

A native of Illinois, Simone attended SUNY Geneseo on a hockey scholarship then continued his studies at Iowa State University, graduating with two professional degrees in architecture.

Gino Antonio

Client Accounts Coordinator

With 20 years of accounting experience, Gino plays an important role at Custom Design & Construction, keeping financial records organized and helping clients navigate financing with confidence and ease. He is known for building genuine relationships with coworkers, clients, and everyone he meets, helping things run smoothly behind the scenes. 

While Gino may spend his days crunching numbers, he is far from a stick in the mud. He loves games of all kinds, enjoys keeping up with sports, and brings great energy to the team. Above all, his greatest joy is spending time with his wife and two children, a role he is most proud of.

From Design to Build, One Team One Dream
Feb 1

At Custom Design & Construction, our work is built by a team of thoughtful, talented people who truly care about what they do and who they do it for. We’re excited to introduce the people behind the process with you.

As a design-build firm, our team is intentionally integrated. From the very beginning, Design and Production work together to create plans that are not only beautiful, but fully buildable.

Your project begins in our Discovery Phase, where you’ll meet with Beth Yuen, Director of Design, and Chelsea Cutler, Designer/General Manager, to talk through your goals, how you live in your home, and what’s possible. From there, our design team develops your space through floor plans and 3D renderings bringing clarity and direction to the vision.

Once the space plan is determined, we move to the Development Phase, our team prepares detailed construction documents and coordinates everything needed for approvals and permitting, setting the project up for a smooth transition into construction.

Beth Yuen

Chelsea Cutler

From there, your project moves into the Bring it to Life Phase, led by our Production Team. Chris Farkas, our Production Manager, oversees the bigger picture, while your dedicated Project Manager, Santos or Ryan, guides the day-to-day work on site. Our in-house field team brings the plans to life with care and craftsmanship, executing every detail with precision.

Chris Farkas

Santos Mejia

Ryan Mejia

This collaboration between Design and Production is what allows us to deliver projects that feel just as good in real life as they did on paper.

We feel incredibly fortunate to have built this team over the past 40 years. It’s what allows us to continue growing, refining our process, and delivering homes our clients can truly fall in love with again.

Our History

Growing up, Frank Sr. learned three core fundamental values from his father, Salvatore Vella, a mason: Take pride in the quality of your workmanship, have a sincere passion for your craft, and do it all with the utmost integrity.Despite only having $100 in his pocket and speaking very little English, in 1965 Frank left Italy in search of the “American Dream”.

As Frank Vella Sr.’s business in his new country grew, so did the need for the first showroom and product diversity. Plumbing and cabinet distributors were sought. In 1976, the Stone Road Showroom opened its doors in Greece, NY, and Vella Ceramic Tile became Vella Bath & Kitchen.

In order to spend time with his children, they would often accompany him on the jobs in hope they too, would grasp the trade. Frank Vella, Jr., his only son, did just that. At a very young age, Frank Jr. became interested in the business and assisted on the jobs and in the showroom.

As the 1980s began, Frank Vella Sr. put his focus into the kitchen market by purchasing materials direct from cabinet and other fixture manufacturers. In turn, they would be sold to some of the area’s largest and prominent builders and contractors within Vella’s wholesale division. This move also allowed Vella Bath and Kitchen to be more in control of obtaining quality materials at competitive pricing. As the decade went by, Vella purchased a countertop fabrication facility that would further streamline quality, lead times, and pricing.

At a young age, Frank Jr., knew his future would be in the family business.He spent his free time after school working and studying the ins/outs of the business. Frank Jr. joined the organization on a full time basis in 1988. Having grown up in the industry, he was ready to lend his personal touch to the continued growth and success of the company.

In 1999, Frank Jr. wanted the business to further stand out from the competition. With that vision, a small plaza was purchased. This new Macedon location would become an expansive kitchen and bath showroom with full culinary center and expanded warehouse.

This expansion led to the integration of full-time remodel employees in 2003. This unique combination of being a kitchen dealer and full service remodeling company positioned Vella Bath & Kitchen to be unlike any other company in the industry. The fundamental belief that Vella does not just sell kitchens and baths, rather it offers its clients the opportunity for enhancing their lives, truly transformed the company into one of Rochester’s leading kitchen and bath companies.
